Many-headed flying hydra with one massive head surrounded by smaller ones. Granted eternal life as guardian of a holy site. Dies if it abandons its sacred duty.

AC 15, HP 33, ATK 1 bite (near) +6 (1d8), MV near (fly, swim), S +5, D +1, C +2, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 6

Heads. Choose how many heads the hydra has. Each is LV 2, AC 15, HP 11, and can make 1 bite attack. A killed head sprouts into two new heads at the start of the hydra's turn unless cauterized beforehand. The hydra's LV is all the heads combined.

Immortal. Can't be killed unless spirit vessel is destroyed or it abandons its holy duty.
